issues.problem: The English adds a factual gloss on the nature of the old garrison abuses — "men on the army rolls who could not also farm" — which has no counterpart in the Chinese; the ZH only says he "set out the abuses of the old garrisons inside and outside the pass" without describing them.
issues.suggestion: Delete "— men on the army rolls who could not also farm —" so the sentence reads "the abuses of the old garrisons inside and outside the pass — and proposed dividing the two".

issues.problem: The English adds "talking of wealth and strength among themselves" as what the overseas powers discussed; the Chinese says only 海外诸国…仍私议以为脆弱 (privately judged China frail), with no mention of wealth and strength.
issues.suggestion: Drop "talking of wealth and strength among themselves, " so it reads "and the overseas powers still whispered that China was frail…".

issues.problem: The English inserts "— a title, roughly governor —" explaining that Pasha is a title; the Chinese gives no such explanation and uses 帕夏 unadorned. A translator's term gloss rather than a content mismatch.
issues.suggestion: Optionally drop "— a title, roughly governor —"; otherwise no change needed.

overall: The English edition tracks the Chinese closely on all facts, dates, numbers, names, quotations and hedges, with only two small explanatory additions in the analysis section and one term gloss needing trimming.
